description: Defines types, structures, and classes related to Type1/Type2 font encoding and face representations in the FreeType project.

classes.name: T1_FaceRec
classes.description: Represents a Type1 font face with associated font data, character maps, and optional PostScript hinter.

classes.name: CID_FaceRec
classes.description: Represents a CID font face with CID-specific data, subroutines, and optional PostScript hinter.
